d:
A mature adult with a muscular, athletic build. The figure is entirely encased in heavy, high-tech power armor featuring a matte olive-drab and slate-grey color palette. A signature gold-tinted visor is set into a matte-grey helmet that obscures the face completely. The armor is bulky and armored, featuring thick plating on the shoulders and chest with integrated mechanical joints.
BODY COLOR: olive-drab
